archive.format: single-member gzip (header 1f8b0800...), no index; HTTP ranges allow prefix reads only

selection.method: Per stratum, rank prompt groups by sha256(seed|prompt|prompt_id); take one video per group, the minimum sha256(seed|video|video_id) among eligible rows; strata filled in listed order; a prompt_id is used at most once across all strata.

definitions.positive: video_labels.porn == true (human S1 on the text-video pair)
definitions.hard_negative: prompt_labels.porn == true (GPT-4 prompt pre-classification) and all 12 video_labels false
definitions.easy_negative: prompt_type == safety_neutral, all prompt_labels false, all video_labels false

exclusions: any child_abuse flag in prompt_labels or video_labels
sexual strata: any age-related term in prompt_text or video_text (screening aid, not proof of adulthood)
selection.is_safe_policy: Not used for selection (undocumented and contradicts video_labels in 587 of 5745 test rows). Recorded per record for a secondary stratified analysis only.
selection.replacement_policy: No substitution after media access or model outputs; excluded or failed records remain in the denominator report.

age_safety.statement: Metadata cannot establish that sexual-content videos depict only adults. All positive and hard_negative records are blocked from media preparation.
age_safety.transfer_consequence: The monolithic gzip cannot be read selectively; any transfer reaching these members moves them onto the machine even if never written to disk.
